factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statement of comprehensive income: Finance costs — net 2025: EUR 4,800 thousand (4.8 million), 2024: EUR 7,357 thousand (7.4 million) — a 34.7% decrease, not 30%; Dividend income tax expense increased from EUR 3,125 thousand (2024) to EUR 5,415 thousand (2025) — +73.3% correct; Share of loss of associate: EUR 26 thousand (2025) vs profit of EUR 487 thousand (2024) — correct partial claim but overall financing expense figure is inaccurate

factual_claims.claim: Capital investments fell 14.4 per cent to EUR 33.2 million, primarily because construction of the multifunctional quay at Paldiski South Harbour concluded early.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report section 5.10: Investments 2025: EUR 33,245 thousand (33.2 million), 2024: EUR 38,831 thousand (38.8 million), change -14.4%; New quay at Paldiski South Harbour completed in early 2026 (Note 5.10)

factual_claims.claim: Future spending is expected to pivot toward terminal shore power infrastructure, which may increase near-term operating costs.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report section 5.10: Future investments include shore power capacity for cruise ships at Old City Harbour and Muuga Harbour, expected to increase near-term operating costs

factual_claims.claim: Consistent with its corporate policy, the Group distributed dividends of EUR 0.073 per share, totalling EUR 19.2 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report section 5.11: Dividend per share EUR 0.073, total EUR 19,199 thousand (19.2 million) (Note 19)

factual_claims.claim: The reporting period highlighted a pronounced recovery in core maritime operations and rigorous cost discipline, effectively translating steady cargo and passenger growth into enhanced profitability while executing major infrastructure milestones.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Synthesis of management report sections 5.6 (operational recovery) and 5.7 (cost discipline), supported by financial results showing profit growth despite revenue decline
